title: zl.lookup
description: look up elements of a list by index

messages.description: performs the operation again on the last received list
0-based indexes of the elements to output
the elements at the given indexes

methods.description: clears the mode's arguments and the data received in both inlets
sets the maximum list size, 1 to 32767

body: [zl.lookup] outputs elements of a stored list: the arguments or the right inlet set the list, and the indexes (0-based) in the left inlet choose the elements.
